items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: I went up Christmas during our vacation to have an audition and play on the radio program with them... And Eddie Dunn, the announcer... And I worked with them a week and then left.

ctx.x: When did you get out of college?

Well, I quit college there in 19... I had 36 then to join the Doe Boys. I'd been there one year. The last semester of the freshman year, the first semester there of the next year. Then I joined them at once. I went up Christmas during our vacation to have an audition and play on the radio program with them somehow. They had a big radio program all over Texas and Oklahoma. And Eddie Dunn, the announcer, kept saying during this week, even though they were featured pianos, but I don't know how the people could have…
So you were going to college. You were kind of working your way through college playing with the Doe Boys.
